dialog.english: ��������You saved us, Whamon!

All that matters to me is that
everyone is safe.
dialog.translation:
Lo único que importa es que
todos estén a salvo.

dialog.english:
Why did the Dark Masters have to
do this?
dialog.translation:
Por qué harían esto
los Amos Oscuros?

dialog.english: I don't know the details.

I only remember that when the
world suddenly began to distort,
it became this way.
dialog.translation:
Solo recuerdo que quedó así
cuando el mundo empezó a
distorsionarse de repente.

dialog.english: Ugh! MetalSeadramon...
Cheer up, Tai.
Yeah... all right. I'll perk up!

That's right. We should all do
that.

I don't know if a single safe
place in this world exists...
dialog.translation:
No sé si existe algún lugar
seguro en este mundo...

dialog.english:
But let us at least search for a
place outside of MetalSeadramon's
reach.
dialog.translation:
Pero busquemos al menos un
lugar fuera del alcance de
MetalSeadramon.

dialog.english: Thanks, Whamon!
Quiet!
This is bad!
The enemy is approaching.
What?!

The fish have seen
MetalSeadramon's minions 200
meters behind us.
dialog.translation:
Los peces vieron secuaces de
MetalSeadramon a 200 metros.

dialog.english: What are we gonna do...
Isn't there *something* we can do?

I can't say for sure because I
don't know how deep they are...
dialog.translation:
No sé bien, porque no sé qué
profundidad tienen...

dialog.english:
But we may be able to throw them
off if we dive.
dialog.translation:
Pero quizá podamos despistarlos
si buceamos.

dialog.english: Please, Whamon!
Let us try!
What's that noise?
Everyone! Please be quiet.

Seems like they're passing
through.
dialog.translation:
Parece que están pasando
de largo.

dialog.english:
We are not in the clear yet. Let's
stay here quietly for a while.
dialog.translation:
Aún no estamos a salvo.
Quedémonos aquí un rato
en silencio.

dialog.english: We did it, Whamon!
But we can't stay here forever...

That's it! May I have a minute,
Kari?
dialog.translation:
Eso es! Me prestas un minuto,
Kari?

dialog.english: What is it, Izzy?

I would like you to use the
whistle you're wearing as sonar.
dialog.translation:
Quiero que uses ese silbato
que llevas como si fuera sonar.

dialog.english:
If Whamon knows what the seabed
looks like, I'm sure he can throw 
them off. Is that okay with you?
dialog.translation:
Si Whamon conoce el fondo
marino, seguro que puede
despistarlos. Te parece bien?

dialog.english: Yeah, of course!
Is that true, Izzy?

Yes, but I need some time to
prepare, so please wait!
dialog.translation:
Sí, pero necesito tiempo
para prepararme, espera!

dialog.english: The preparations are finished!
This'll work for sure!

So I just need to blow the
whistle?
Please do.
Okay...

It worked! There are some tunnels
nearby that we can use.
dialog.translation:
Funcionó! Hay unos túneles
cerca que podemos usar.

dialog.english:
Yes. I also felt it. It seems that
these holes also lead to the
surface.
dialog.translation:
Sí, yo también lo noté. Estos
agujeros también llevan
a la superficie.

dialog.english: We did it!
We're saved!
Great job, Izzy!
This is a problem...
What's wrong, Izzy?

Well...there are multiple tunnels,
so I'm wondering which ones we
should use.
dialog.translation:
Bueno... hay varios túneles,
y no sé cuáles deberíamos
usar.

dialog.english: Huh? Well, I can decide for you.
dialog.translation: Eh? Bueno, yo decido por ti.

dialog.english:
Really? All right, then, should we
take the one on the right or the
one on the left?
dialog.translation:
En serio? Vale, entonces
tomamos el de la derecha o
el de la izquierda?

dialog.english: Hmm...
The one on the right
The one on the left

Understood! Please take us there,
Whamon!
Aye-aye, sir!

It's a dead end! We can't go any
further...
dialog.translation:
Callejón sin salida! No
podemos seguir...

dialog.english: Oops...

There's nothing we can do. Let's
return.
dialog.translation:
No hay nada que hacer.
Volvamos.

dialog.english:
We're approaching the surface! Oh,
my, there are more tunnels here.
dialog.translation:
Nos acercamos a la superficie!
Vaya, hay más túneles aquí.

dialog.english:
Whew. Well, we got through the
first one for now.
dialog.translation:
Uf. Bueno, superamos el
primero por ahora.

dialog.english: We did!

The one on the right, the one on
the left, or the one in the
middle, which hole should we take?
dialog.translation:
El de la derecha, el de la
izquierda o el del medio,
cuál agujero tomamos?

dialog.english: Uh...
The one on the right
The one in the middle
The one on the left

Understood! Please take us there,
Whamon!
Aye-aye, sir!

We're even closer to the surface.
But there are even more tunnels
here...
dialog.translation:
Estamos aún más cerca de la
superficie. Pero hay más
túneles aquí...

dialog.english:
All right, we got through the
second one!
I'm feeling good about this!

I found an undersea cave where we
can make a landing!
dialog.translation:
Encontré una cueva submarina
para desembarcar!

dialog.english: All right, see if you can land!

Yes, we may be able to find
something interesting.
Okay, let's head back!
Then, we shall depart!

This won't work, it's too narrow!
I can't continue this way...
dialog.translation:
Esto no va, es muy estrecho!
No puedo seguir así...

dialog.english: That didn't work out...
Nothing we can do. Let's return.
dialog.translation:
No hay nada que hacer.
Volvamos.

dialog.english:
The one on the right, the one on
the left, or the one in the
middle, which hole should we take?
dialog.translation:
El de la derecha, el de la
izquierda o el del medio,
cuál agujero tomamos?

dialog.english: Hmmmmmm...
The one on the right
The one in the middle
The one on the left

All right, Whamon, please take us
there!
Aye-aye, sir!

We really are approaching the
surface!
dialog.translation:
Nos acercamos de veras
a la superficie!

dialog.english: Great, keep it up!

Just a little more! Please keep at
it!
dialog.translation:
Un poco más! Sigue así,
por favor!

dialog.english:
There are still more, should we
take the hole on the right, the
left hole, or the middle hole?
dialog.translation:
Aún hay más, tomamos el
agujero de la derecha, el
de la izquierda o el medio?

dialog.english: Okay...
The one on the right
The one in the middle
The one on the left

Then, please take us there,
Whamon!
Aye-aye, sir!

It's a dead end! We can't go any
further…
dialog.translation:
Callejón sin salida! No
podemos seguir...

dialog.english: Oops...

This kind of thing happens, so
let's return.
dialog.translation:
Estas cosas pasan, así que
volvamos.

dialog.english:
I found an undersea cave where we
can make a landing! But it seems
like it will be difficult...
dialog.translation:
Encontré una cueva submarina
para desembarcar! Pero parece
que será difícil...

dialog.english: Well, at least try!

We don't know what might be there,
so please, be careful.
dialog.translation:
No sabemos qué puede haber
ahí, así que id con cuidado.

dialog.english: All right, let's go back!
Then, we shall depart!
We're almost be at the surface!
We did it!

Just a little more! Please keep at
it!
dialog.translation:
Un poco más! Sigue así,
por favor!

dialog.english:
There are two more holes. Should
we take the one on the right or
the one on the left?
dialog.translation:
Quedan dos agujeros más.
Tomamos el de la derecha
o el de la izquierda?

dialog.english: What should we do...
The one on the right
The one on the left

Understood! Please take us there,
Whamon!
Aye-aye, sir!
We'll almost be at the surface!
We did it!

Just a little more! Please keep at
it!
dialog.translation:
Un poco más! Sigue así,
por favor!

dialog.english:
It's an undersea cave! I can make
a landing here.
dialog.translation:
Es una cueva submarina! Puedo
desembarcar aquí.

dialog.english: Okay, try to land there!

Please be careful and try not to
get lost.
dialog.translation:
Ten cuidado y procura
no perderte.

dialog.english: All right, let's go back!
Then, we shall depart!

Once we exit this tunnel, we'll be
at the surface.
dialog.translation:
Al salir de este túnel,
estaremos en la superficie.

dialog.english: Really?!

Looks like we managed to throw 'em
off.

And... I apologize, but may I rest
for a little?
dialog.translation:
Y... disculpad, pero puedo
descansar un poco?

dialog.english:
Sorry for pushing you so hard,
Whamon. Take your time.
dialog.translation:
Perdona por exigirte tanto,
Whamon. Tómate tu tiempo.

dialog.english: All right...
We should take a break, too.
Everyone!
What's wrong?

MetalSeadramon's catching up to us
at great speed!
dialog.translation:
MetalSeadramon nos alcanza
a toda velocidad!

dialog.english: N-No way...

Have you had fun playing
submarine, Chosen Children?
dialog.translation:
Os gustó jugar a
submarinistas, Niños Elegidos?

dialog.english:
No matter what it takes, I shall
get you to the surface!
dialog.translation:
Cueste lo que cueste, os
llevaré a la superficie!

dialog.english:
We're counting on you, Whamon.
Hang in there!
Please leave it to me!

How far do you think you can run
from me? Hahahaha!
dialog.translation:
Hasta dónde creéis que podéis
huir de mí? Jajajaja!

dialog.english:
I'm sorry, but all of you must
stay here!
dialog.translation:
Lo siento, pero debéis
quedar aquí, todos!

dialog.english: Whamon!
What are you doing?

I'm going to hold back
MetalSeadramon for as long as I
can!
dialog.translation:
Voy a contener a
MetalSeadramon todo el
tiempo que pueda!

dialog.english: No! That's a death sentence!
He's coming!

Have you chosen this place as your
graves, Chosen Children?
dialog.translation:
Habéis elegido este lugar
como vuestra tumba,
Niños Elegidos?

dialog.english:
I won't allow you to do as you
please! Go, children!
dialog.translation:
No os dejaré hacer lo que
queráis! Marchaos, niños!

dialog.english: Aaaaah!
Whamon!
I'm not playing around!
Gaaaaaaaah!
Whamon!
Whaaaaamoooooooon!

Hmph, how pathetic... now it's
your turn!
dialog.translation:
Qué patético... ahora
os toca a vosotros!

dialog.english: No...
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
Gaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
We won...
Hnyaaaah... I'm starving.
Whamon...
The ocean is returning...
...from Spiral Mountain...
Why?!

We defeated MetalSeadramon, who
was controlling the ocean!
dialog.translation:
Derrotamos a MetalSeadramon,
que controlaba el océano!

dialog.english:
So the dark forces are
disappearing...

The powers of darkness disappeared
when we won...
dialog.translation:
El poder de la oscuridad
desapareció al ganar...

dialog.english:
Don't stray too far away from us,
Kari.
dialog.translation:
No te alejes mucho de
nosotros, Kari.

dialog.english:
Kari... I'm sorry I couldn't
protect you back in Odaiba.
dialog.translation:
Kari... siento no haber
podido protegerte en Odaiba.

dialog.english: Don't worry about it!
I acted out on my own will.

I know you and Sora were trying
really hard to protect me.
dialog.translation:
Sé que tú y Sora os
esforzasteis mucho por
protegerme.

dialog.english:
I always wanted to apologize, so
I'm really happy that I could talk
to you about this.
dialog.translation:
Siempre quise disculparme,
así que me alegra mucho
poder hablarlo contigo.

dialog.english:
It's not your or Sora's fault, so
please don't worry about it...
dialog.translation:
No es culpa tuya ni de Sora,
así que no te preocupes...

dialog.english:
But despite all that, I wasn't
able to keep my promise to
Tai...
dialog.translation:
Pero aun así, no pude
cumplir mi promesa a
Tai...

dialog.english: Matt...
If I were stronger...

So you got to come to the Digital
World too, Kari...
dialog.translation:
Así que tú también viniste
al Digimundo, Kari...

dialog.english:
Is your whistle important to you,
Kari?
dialog.translation:
Es importante para ti
ese silbato, Kari?

dialog.english: I've been wearing it since infancy.
It doesn't have any special meaning.

It became a sort of habit. If I'm
not wearing it, I get nervous.
dialog.translation:
Se volvió una costumbre. Si
no lo llevo, me pongo
nerviosa.

dialog.english:
I see. The truth is, I can't feel
calm when I don't have my
computer.
dialog.translation:
Ya veo. La verdad es que no
me siento tranquilo sin mi
ordenador.

dialog.english: That's pretty similar!

I don't really remember, but I've
been wearing it since I was a
baby...
dialog.translation:
La verdad es que no recuerdo,
pero lo llevo desde que era
bebé...

dialog.english:
I'm sorry for asking that out of 
the blue. If I ever say something 
that bothers you, please tell me.
dialog.translation:
Perdona por preguntar eso de
repente. Si alguna vez digo
algo que te moleste, dímelo.

dialog.english:
I'm sorry, but I need a little
more time to prepare...
dialog.translation:
Lo siento, pero necesito un
poco más de tiempo...

dialog.english:
How about you talk to someone else
in the meantime?
dialog.translation:
Por qué no hablas con otro
mientras tanto?

dialog.english: Should we get to departing now?
Please wait a little longer.
We're good to go!

Hey, Kari. I've always wondered
about something.
dialog.translation:
Oye, Kari. Siempre he tenido
una duda.

dialog.english: What is it, Mimi?

Didn't going to the Digital World
sound scary?
dialog.translation:
No te dio miedo venir al
Digimundo?

dialog.english: I'm not scared if I'm with Tai.
dialog.translation:
No tengo miedo si estoy con
Tai.

dialog.english: I know I'm a Chosen Child, so...
dialog.translation:
Sé que soy Niña Elegida,
así...

dialog.english:
I wanted to go back to my world,
so I started crying...
dialog.translation:
Quería volver a mi mundo,
así que me puse a llorar...

dialog.english:
You're a really tough girl,
Kari.
dialog.translation:
Eres una chica muy fuerte,
Kari.

dialog.english: No, I'm not really!

And I really wanted to see the
world the Digimon come from, too.
dialog.translation:
Y también quería ver de
dónde vienen los Digimon.

dialog.english:
If I were you, I'd have said that
I'm not going, no matter what.
dialog.translation:
Si fuera tú, habría dicho que
no iba, pasara lo que pasara.

dialog.english: Heehee... oh, Mimi!

We're going to have to be in this
world for a lot longer, huh...
dialog.translation:
Vamos a tener que estar en
este mundo mucho más tiempo...

dialog.english:
It's your first time being inside
Whamon. Are you okay with that?
dialog.translation:
Es tu primera vez dentro de
Whamon. Te parece bien?

dialog.english: It's a little hard to walk.
I feel like he's protecting us.

Yeah, you're right. But it's not
bad when you get used to it.
dialog.translation:
Sí, tienes razón. Pero no está
mal cuando te acostumbras.

dialog.english: I'm sorry for being a bother.

It feels reassuring being in
Whamon's body.
dialog.translation:
Da tranquilidad estar
dentro de Whamon.

dialog.english:
Yeah, I feel the same. Whamon's
super reliable.
dialog.translation:
Sí, opino igual. Whamon es
super fiable.

dialog.english:
I was really surprised when Whamon
swallowed us...
dialog.translation:
Me sorprendió mucho cuando
Whamon nos tragó...

dialog.english: Let's do our best! Together!

Whamon helped us get to Server
Continent...
dialog.translation:
Whamon nos llevó al
Continente Server...

dialog.english:
Are you tired, Kari? If you want
to take a break, tell us right
away.
dialog.translation:
Estás cansada, Kari? Si
quieres parar un momento,
dínoslo enseguida.

dialog.english: Well, if you insist...
No, I'm fine.
All right. I'll tell Tai.
dialog.translation: Vale, se lo diré a Tai.

dialog.english: Thanks, Matt.
Really? You don't look fine...

Sorry for making you worry about
me.

N-No, you don't have to worry
about that. You just got to the
Digital World, after all.
dialog.translation:
N-No, no tienes que
preocuparte por eso. Acabas
de llegar al Digimundo.

dialog.english:
But... everyone else is working so
hard...
dialog.translation:
Pero... los demás se esfuerzan
tanto...

dialog.english:
Maybe I said something I shouldn't
have...
dialog.translation:
Quizá dije algo que no
debía...

dialog.english:
We don't really have the time to
be taking it easy...
dialog.translation:
La verdad es que no tenemos
tiempo para relajarnos...

dialog.english:
What do you usually do during the
day, Kari?
dialog.translation:
Qué sueles hacer durante
el día, Kari?

dialog.english:
I don't go out that much. I play
with Miko at home.
dialog.translation:
No salgo mucho. Juego con
Miko en casa.

dialog.english:
So when we get back, you should
come to my place and play.
dialog.translation:
Cuando volvamos, deberías
venir a jugar a mi casa.

dialog.english: With Tai, of course!
Really? Okay!
With Tai... well, that works!
Please come anytime you like.

I wonder if I should invite Mimi,
too...
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto si invitar
también a Mimi...

dialog.english:
Um... if we take this course...
here...
dialog.translation:
Um... si tomamos este rumbo...
aquí...

dialog.english:
You can do anything, Izzy!
Like using my whistle as sonar!
dialog.translation:
Puedes con todo, Izzy! Como
usar mi silbato de sonar!

dialog.english:
Hahaha... well, it's not me who
can do anything, it's my computer.
dialog.translation:
Jajaja... bueno, no soy yo el
que puede con todo, es mi
ordenador.

dialog.english: You're the one using it, Izzy.
dialog.translation:
Pero tú eres quien lo usa,
Izzy.

dialog.english: If I could use a computer...

Well, that's the one thing I'm
good at.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, es lo único que se
me da bien.

dialog.english:
All right, I'll teach you how to
use it. I'll teach Tai how to
use it, too.
dialog.translation:
Vale, te enseñaré a usarlo.
También le enseñaré a Tai.

dialog.english: Thanks, Izzy!

I wonder what Gennai's doing right
now…
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto qué hará Gennai
ahora...

dialog.english:
Hmph, even though we're at the
ocean, I can't go sunbathing...
dialog.translation:
Ja, aunque estemos en el mar,
no puedo tomar el sol...

dialog.english: Do you like sunbathing, Mimi?
dialog.translation:
Te gusta tomar el sol,
Mimi?

dialog.english:
If you wanna go sunbathing, you've
got to go to Hawaii or Guam. Which
do you like more, Kari?
dialog.translation:
Si quieres tomar el sol, hay
que ir a Hawái o Guam. Cuál
te gusta más, Kari?

dialog.english: Guam?
Hawaii?

Guam's nice, but I like Hawaii
more.
dialog.translation:
Guam mola, pero me gusta más
Hawái.

dialog.english:
I agree. I've got to work hard
here so I can save Hawaii, too!
dialog.translation:
Opino igual. Tengo que
esforzarme para salvar
también Hawái!

dialog.english:
Because at this rate, it's gonna
be weird if it starts snowing in
Hawaii, right?
dialog.translation:
Porque a este ritmo, sería raro
que nevara en Hawái, no?

dialog.english:
I'm going to do my best to protect
Hawaii!
dialog.translation:
Voy a esforzarme para
proteger Hawái!

dialog.english: And I'll do my best for everyone!
dialog.translation:
Y yo daré lo mejor por
todos!

dialog.english:
We've got to bring peace back to
the Digital World's oceans!
dialog.translation:
Debemos devolver la paz a
los océanos del Digimundo!

dialog.english:
We got this far because of Whamon,
but what are we going to do now?
dialog.translation:
Llegamos hasta aquí gracias
a Whamon, pero qué haremos
ahora?

dialog.english: If we gathered allies...
If we could all Ultimate evolve...

Yeah, but our enemies are all
Ultimates. We can't stand up to
them like this.
dialog.translation:
Sí, pero los enemigos son
todos Perfecto. Así no
podemos hacerles frente.

dialog.english: But...

Agumon and Gabumon were able to
evolve to Ultimate with a miracle.
dialog.translation:
Agumon y Gabumon lograron
evolucionar a Perfecto
con un milagro.

dialog.english:
But would it be that weird for a
miracle to happen again?
dialog.translation:
Sería tan raro que
volviera a pasar
un milagro?

dialog.english: Well, that's...
It's technically not impossible!

You're right... yeah, you're
right!
Yeah!
If Gomamon evolved to Ultimate...
So you live in Odaiba, Kari?
Yeah!

I live in Sangenjaya, so it'd be
pretty hard for us to play
together when we get back.
dialog.translation:
Yo vivo en Sangenjaya, así que
será difícil que juguemos
juntas cuando volvamos.

dialog.english: I can meet you at Matt's house.
dialog.translation: Puedo verte en casa de Matt.

dialog.english: It'd be nice if you moved to Odaiba.
dialog.translation:
Estaría bien que te
mudaras a Odaiba.

dialog.english:
You're right! Let's play together
then.
Okay!
But my mom doesn't like Odaiba...
dialog.translation:
A mi madre no le gusta
Odaiba...

dialog.english: Really...?

I'll ask my mom about moving when
we go back to our world.
dialog.translation:
Le preguntaré a mamá
si podemos mudarnos.

dialog.english: Hope it goes well!

I wonder why people always get
into fights just when they've been
getting along so well...
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto por qué la gente
siempre pelea justo cuando
se llevaba tan bien...

dialog.english:
When you want to return to the
sea, please approach the back of
the waterfront.
dialog.translation:
Cuando queráis volver al
mar, acercaos a la parte
trasera del muelle.

dialog.english: Return from the back, got it.
Everyone, are you done exploring?
Uh...
Just a bit more left to do!
Yeah! We're done!
Then, I will wait in the sea!
dialog.translation:
Entonces os espero en
el mar!

dialog.english: Then, let us return to the sea!

It's slippery around here, Kari.
Be careful.
dialog.translation:
Aquí resbala mucho, Kari.
Ten cuidado.

dialog.english: I'll be careful. It'll be fine.
T.K! It's dangerous there!

Aren't you jinxing yourself by
saying that?
dialog.translation:
No estarás gafándote al
decir eso?

dialog.english: No, I wo... ah!
Careful! Grab onto my hand!

Thank you! I'll pay better
attention!
Aaaaaah! Whew.

You could have fallen if you'd
stayed there any longer.
dialog.translation:
Podrías haberte caído si te
quedabas ahí más tiempo.

dialog.english:
How embarrassing... I'll be more
careful from now on...
dialog.translation:
Qué vergüenza... tendré más
cuidado a partir de ahora...

dialog.english:
Good thing the water Digimon
'round here are all peaceful.
dialog.translation:
Menos mal que los Digimon
acuáticos de aquí son
pacíficos.

dialog.english:
Because of the convoluted nature
of the trench, they can live here,
hiding from large Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Gracias a lo laberíntico de
la fosa, pueden vivir aquí,
escondidos de Digimon grandes.

dialog.english: You're a Digimon PhD, Izzy
dialog.translation:
Eres un doctor en Digimon,
Izzy

dialog.english: Digimon ecology's quite interesting

No, I've still got a long way to
go.
dialog.translation:
No, aún me queda mucho
por aprender.

dialog.english:
Izzy could become a Digimon
scholar.
dialog.translation:
Izzy podría ser un
erudito en Digimon.

dialog.english: I think so, too.
W-Well, maybe.

If I had the time, I'd like to
look more into it.
dialog.translation:
Si tuviera tiempo, me
gustaría investigarlo
más.

dialog.english:
You're not gon' dissect me, are
you? I don't wanna even think
'bout that!
dialog.translation:
No pensarás diseccionarme,
verdad? Ni de broma quiero
pensar en eso!

dialog.english: ...Huh?

That ain't the response I wanted
to hear! *shiver*
dialog.translation:
Esa no era la respuesta que
esperaba! (escalofríos)

dialog.english: Hey, Kari! This way!
Thanks, Matt!
You're welcome.
You're really reliable, Matt.
You're so reliable, like my brother.
dialog.translation:
Eres tan fiable como mi
hermano.

dialog.english:
Compared to my brother, you get a
lot more done.
dialog.translation:
Comparado con mi hermano,
consigues mucho más.

dialog.english:
R-Really...? Well, Tai's got
more of the whole leadership
factor going on...
dialog.translation:
E-En serio...? Bueno, Tai
tiene más eso de ser
el líder...

dialog.english: You seem really happy...?
Y-Yeah... I am, right?

(He doesn't seem happy about that
at all...?)

Are you feeling bad because of the
clammy atmosphere, Mimi?
dialog.translation:
Te sienta mal el ambiente
tan húmedo, Mimi?

dialog.english: Don't you hate all the sliminess?
I don't particularly like it...
I don't particularly hate it...

Right? There's all kinds of slimy
Digimon in this kind of place,
but...
dialog.translation:
Verdad? Hay todo tipo de
Digimon viscosos en
sitios así, pero...

dialog.english:
I haven't seen those guys
recently... I wonder how they're
doing right now?
dialog.translation:
No he visto a esos tipos
últimamente... me pregunto
cómo estarán ahora?

dialog.english:
Yeah. Even things like fermented
soybeans can be delicious!
dialog.translation:
Sí. Hasta cosas como la soja
fermentada puede estar rica!

dialog.english: I like fermented soybeans, too.

Really?! They're the best on fried
eggs.
dialog.translation:
En serio?! Van genial con
huevos fritos.

dialog.english: Huh?! Well...

By the way, there's all kinds of
slimy Digimon in this kind of
place, but...
dialog.translation:
Por cierto, hay todo tipo de
Digimon viscosos en sitios
así, pero...

dialog.english:
I haven't seen those guys
recently... I wonder how they're
doing right now?
dialog.translation:
No he visto a esos tipos
últimamente... me pregunto
cómo estarán ahora?

dialog.english: Hey, Kari, aren't you tired?
Just a little...
You don't look good yourself, Joe.
dialog.translation:
Tampoco tú tienes buena
cara, Joe.

dialog.english: Okay, be sure to take it slow.
You're like a leader, Joe!

Huh?! R-Really... Have I finally
become a leader?
dialog.translation:
Eh?! D-De verdad... Al fin
me he vuelto un líder?

dialog.english:
My stomach has been hurting for a 
while. I didn't expect you to see 
through me like that, Kari.
dialog.translation:
Me duele el estómago desde
hace rato. No esperaba que
me calaras así, Kari.

dialog.english:
So does that mean... you weren't
actually that worried about me?
dialog.translation:
Entonces eso significa...
no estabas tan preocupada
por mí?

dialog.english: Huh?!
*glare*

N-No, that's not it! I was worried
about you too, Kari!
dialog.translation:
N-No, no es eso! También
estaba preocupado por ti,
Kari!

dialog.english: ...Hmph.

I was really surprised when it
turned out you were the eighth
Chosen Child, Kari.
dialog.translation:
Me sorprendió mucho descubrir
que eras la octava Niña
Elegida, Kari.

dialog.english: I didn't know at the time, either.
I feel like it was fate.

Yeah, it all happened so suddenly.
If anything comes up, just let me
know.
dialog.translation:
Sí, todo pasó de repente. Si
necesitas algo, avísame.

dialog.english: Thanks, Sora!

There were tons of kids who lived
in Karigaoka, but...
dialog.translation:
Había un montón de niños
en Hikarioka, pero...

dialog.english:
It's really amazing that the eight
of us are here now.
dialog.translation:
Es increíble que los ocho
estemos aquí ahora.

dialog.english:
It was all by chance, but I think
the fact we're all here now turned
out to be for the better.
dialog.translation:
Fue todo casualidad, pero creo
que estar todos aquí ahora
fue para mejor.

dialog.english:
No! It wasn't by chance, but
fate...
dialog.translation:
No! No fue casualidad,
fue destino...

dialog.english:
You're pretty certain about that,
specifically.
dialog.translation:
Qué seguro estás de eso,
la verdad.
